name: removexattr
description: removexattr() removes the specified extended attribute from the file at the given path. lremovexattr() does the same but for symbolic links without following them, while fremovexattr() removes it from an open file descriptor.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file or directory

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute to remove

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file (for fremovexattr only)

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The named attribute does not exist
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem, or are disabled
Errors documented in stat(2) can also occur
